description: Fixed questions for the four-tool policy (quad) versus the context tool. Graders check that the tool output contains the facts (information sufficiency), the same kind of check as Suite 1. Anchors are checked against the files before any timed run so a wrong checkout cannot be scored.
decision: Adopt context if its strict pass rate on this set is not below quad, its median result tokens are not higher than quad by more than quad's run-to-run range, and its external call count is less than or equal to quad. A median latency increase above 50% or a peak RSS above 2x on the chromium questions is a negative perf result, not a win. A gap smaller than the 5-run range is no measurable difference.

chromium.note: Stable snapshot of a sparse checkout of github.com/chromium/chromium at this commit: cones base, net/base, and content/browser/renderer_host (5712 files, about 72 MiB). Not a depot_tools Chromium tree and not third_party. A full working-tree checkout of the same commit was still downloading blobs when this set was frozen; the snapshot was copied so runs would not race that checkout.
